The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. पू 'to purify' 2. लू 'to cut' when निर् and अभि are respectively in composition.

Terms: घञ्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'completed thereby' after the words अक्षद्यूत etc. being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The words निरुदकetc. Have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

Terms:

A वलादि आर्धधातुक affix optionally takes इट् after कुष् when it is preceded by निर्।

Terms: इट् augment

The word निर्वाण is irregularly formed by changing the निष्ठा त is changed to न when the sense is not that of 'wind'.

Terms: निष्ठा changes
